original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚安全部门就20名NYSC成员绑架案提审3名嫌疑人
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚国家安全局（SSS）在奥韦里Mgbidi高等法院提审3名嫌疑人，他们被指涉嫌参与近期在伊莫州绑架20名国家青年服务团（NYSC）成员一案。检方称，被告与其他在逃人员涉嫌于10月1日凌晨在奥尼查—奥韦里高速公路Mgbidi路段实施绑架，并向受害者家属索要并收取4800万奈拉及部分美元后才释放人质。被告对共谋劫持人质、绑架及非法持有枪支弹药三项指控均不认罪。

location.raw_text: Mgbidi High Court sitting in Owerri, Imo State

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚国家安全局提审3名涉嫌参与绑架20名NYSC成员的嫌疑人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: THE State Security Services (SSS), on Tuesday, arraigned three suspects before the Mgbidi High Court sitting in Owerri over their alleged involvement in the recent kidnap of 20 National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) members in Imo State.

key_facts.fact: 3名嫌疑人分别被控共谋劫持人质、绑架及非法持有枪支弹药
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: They were arraigned on a three-count charge of conspiracy to hostage taking, abduction and unlawful possession of firearms and ammunition.

key_facts.fact: 检方称绑架发生于10月1日凌晨奥尼查—奥韦里高速公路Mgbidi路段
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the defendants and others at large allegedly conspired and carried out the kidnap in the early hours of October 1, around the Mgbidi axis of the Onitsha – Owerri Expressway

key_facts.fact: 检方称被告向受害者家属索要并收取4800万奈拉及部分美元
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the defendants allegedly demanded and received N48 million and some dollars from the families of the victims before their release
The defendants, however, pleaded not guilty to the charges.

uncertainties: 嫌疑人的涉案行为属检方指控，尚未经法院判决确认
目前仅有一个来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
